findings.fix: Call the scroller's reveal on the active tab after openTab (KOS.ui.scroller({reveal})).

findings.title: Post-mortem's empty state stretches 'Marks by question' into a 1166px pill under one short sentence
findings.evidence: /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS - Web/audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/exams-files-ink/b4-attempt-mac.png (button 258..1424 px wide); js/modules/examprac.js:337 (u.card([u.quiet(...), u.btn('Marks by question','primary sm')]) – the card is a column flex so the button stretches)
findings.fix: Put the button inline (align-self:flex-start) or move the CTA into the hero and drop the duplicate sentence.

findings.title: Timed paper: a reload does not come back paused, contrary to the module's documented contract
findings.evidence: Started timed, reloaded: state.ui.examPaperSess.paused null, Pause button reads 'Pause', clock 2:28:15 still counting (/Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS - Web/audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/exams-files-ink/b4-timed-reload-ipadl.png); js/modules/exampaperview.js:16-17 (comment) vs :157 (no-op)
findings.fix: Decide the rule: set s.paused = Date.now() on a fresh page load (like Focus, invariant 4c) or remove the dead line and fix the comment.

findings.title: Paper library says your PDFs 'never sync … and are never uploaded' while offering 'Keep in my cloud' and showing a 'Synced' row
findings.evidence: /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS - Web/audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/exams-files-ink/b4-practice-library-ipad.png; CLAUDE.md invariant 125 ('A paper stays on the device … unless you press "Keep in my cloud"')
findings.fix: Reword: 'They stay in this browser unless you press Keep in my cloud on a paper; they are never in a backup.'

findings.title: Scan pages dialog: an emoji camera icon, instructions shown before any photo, and a 'Remove this page' button styled like a disabled primary
findings.evidence: /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS - Web/audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/exams-files-ink/b4-scan-ipad.png, /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS - Web/audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/exams-files-ink/b4-scan-photo-ipad.png; js/core/filescan.js (scan.take label, scan.drop)
findings.fix: Use the app's glyph style for the camera, show the drag instruction only once a photo is on the stage, and style Remove as a quiet danger link.

findings.title: Three different file-size formatters: the same 16-byte file is '1 KB' in Files, '0 KB' in Storage and '16 B' on a topic's Files tab; Storage lists '0 KB' rows
findings.evidence: /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS - Web/audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/exams-files-ink/b4-storage-ipad.png, /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS - Web/audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/exams-files-ink/b4-files-ipad.png; js/modules/storage.js:22, js/modules/files.js:20, js/modules/attachments.js:596-598
findings.fix: One size formatter in KOS.ui (or KOS.files) used by all three; hide zero rows or say 'none'; let the Free up space card shrink or merge with Files in your cloud while signed out.

findings.title: New assessment dialog: the two-column form leaves holes (Duration, Extra time, Target grade each alone on a row) and pre-fills the Title with 'Real exam'
findings.evidence: /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS - Web/audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/exams-files-ink/b4-editor-ipad.png; measured dialog 760x1148 scrollHeight 1252; inputs 39-42px tall; iPhone computed font-size 13.5px on .k-input; js/modules/exams.js editor() (exams.title value), css/base.css:159 vs css/components.css:414
findings.fix: Pair the singles (Duration+Extra time, Target grade+Calculator) so the grid has no holes; use the tier name as a placeholder and derive the title on save only when empty.

findings.title: Readiness band prints 'limiting: RAG' under 'Not enough evidence' — a limiting signal named when there is no evidence at all
findings.evidence: /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS - Web/audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/exams-files-ink/b4-season-dawn-mac.png (all five season cards); eval fixture output band.thin limit rag; js/modules/exams.js:93-103 (comment vs `var lim = b.band === 'ready' ? null : b.limitName`)
findings.fix: Show the limit only for at_risk, and for on_track only when one signal is weak; for Thin say which signals are silent ('needs: recall, a timed paper').

findings.title: Practice's empty state points to a '+ Log entry' button that does not exist (the button is '+ Log a result') and offers no action of its own
findings.evidence: /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS - Web/audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/exams-files-ink/b4-empty-practice-iphone.png; js/modules/tracker.js:460
findings.fix: Give the empty state the action itself (KOS.ui.emptyState({action: Log a result})) and use the same label as the header.

findings.title: An open dialog survives Back/hash navigation: the 'Mark it yourself' tally stayed on screen over the next pages
findings.evidence: shots taken after navigating with the tally open showed it over each page (first attempt of b4-results-ipad.png); js/core/router.js:284-306 (onPop/hashchange render with no dialog handling)
findings.fix: On a navigation render, close (or ask about) open dialogs — or treat Back while a dialog is open as closing the dialog, as native sheets do.
